escalations.title: postcss XSS & Path Traversal (4 CVEs)

backlog.title: Direct store access from route handlers
backlog.description: Route handlers import and call workItemStore functions directly, bypassing the service layer. Violates CLAUDE.md architecture rule.
backlog.recommendation: Extract workItemService.ts; all routes call service layer only.

backlog.title: Missing blocked_by field in API types + unsafe as-any casts
backlog.description: FR-dependency-api-types requires blocked_by?: string[] on UpdateBugInput and UpdateFeatureRequestInput. Field is missing, forcing as any casts in DependencyPicker.tsx:291,293.
backlog.recommendation: Add blocked_by field to both interfaces; remove as any casts.

backlog.title: Missing seed file in portal/Backend
backlog.description: FR-dependency-seed requires idempotent seed.ts with 4 known dependency relationships. File missing from portal/Backend/src/database/.
backlog.recommendation: Create seed.ts per spec; wire into index.ts startup.

backlog.title: Missing DependencySection and BlockedBadge component tests
backlog.description: FR-dependency-frontend-tests requires both test files. Only DependencyPicker.test.tsx exists. DependencySection and BlockedBadge have zero test coverage.
backlog.recommendation: Create both test files with // Verifies: FR-dependency-frontend-tests comments.

backlog.title: Tiered Merge Pipeline FRs not scanned by traceability enforcer
backlog.description: FR-TMP-001–010 are implemented in platform/ which is excluded from the enforcer's scan dirs. Regressions in these requirements would not be caught automatically.
backlog.recommendation: Add Plans/tiered-merge-pipeline/requirements.md and extend enforcer to platform/, or add per-plan Makefile targets.

backlog.recommendation: Add inline comment explaining the deliberate dependency array omission.
